subject: dbc_contracts
summary: Reservation::expire elevates W5 TTL-expiry restore to checkable DbC at standard density: pre HoldExists and HoldPastTtl, post AvailableStockRestoredOnExpiry and HoldRemoved, plus no-mutation posts for HoldMissing / HoldNotPastTtl with PreconditionError named in comments. Injectable clock / expiresAt-in-past checkability is documented. W1–W4 reserve/release pre/post (authZ, stock, InsufficientStock, Unauthorized, release restore) remain intact and are not thinned. No vacuous pre:true; no missing-precondition hole for known failure modes.

findings.detail: lint: ambiguous phrase 'sufficient' in Brief scope text
Success posts are unguarded (same pattern as release). Stronger OCL would imply under HoldExists@pre and HoldPastTtl; checkability remains via those pres and the failure no-mutation posts.

HoldMissing failure asserts holds() unchanged but does not mirror AvailableStockUnchanged (HoldNotPastTtl has that post). When the hold is absent there is no SKU to restore—adequate at standard density; optional symmetry polish only.

HoldExists / HoldPastTtl violations name PreconditionError in comments only (aligned with OpenAPI 400 HoldMissing / HoldNotPastTtl). OCL text need not spell the exception class—pre clauses are present; not a missing-precondition hole.
